description: Use this when the user asks for details about one specific US funding program — what it funds, how much, who it's for, deadline and status, how long applying takes. Returns public program facts and a link to the program page. For "do I qualify" use check_eligibility instead. Not for non-US programs or scholarships.

program_name.description: The program's name, if no slug is known.

slug.description: The program's slug from search_grants results (preferred).

name: get_grant
title: Get US grant details
